# nudge appoints Debi Kesselring and Greg Goebert as Vice Presidents, U.S.

nudge appoints Debi Kesselring and Greg Goebert as Vice Presidents, U.S., to drive the next stage of growth and support employers operating across the United States.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6a8706299167daed6578ee77/6ada6603e1c9caf74d84239e_News_US%20VP%20announcement.png)

October 15, 2026

•

Read time:

1

minutes

By

Team nudge

Contents

October 2026, nudge has appointed Debi Kesselring and Greg Goebert as Vice Presidents, U.S., strengthening its leadership as the global financial health platform accelerates growth with employers operating across the United States.

Kesselring brings deep experience across the U.S. benefits industry, with a career spanning MetLife, Allstate Benefits, and The Standard, partnering with leading consultants and organizations on their benefits strategies and employee communications.

Goebert brings extensive experience consulting on U.S. employee benefits, most recently at Insperity, and joins nudge to help more employers get greater value from their benefits.

At nudge, Kesselring and Goebert will focus on growing the company’s U.S. client base and expanding its network of Total Reward and Benefit consultants.

#### **Continuing growth in the U.S.**

The appointments come as U.S. employers and their consultants look for financial health providers that deliver a measurable return on investment, from higher benefit utilization to stronger retention.

Jeff Miller, Executive Vice President, Americas said:

> With our U.S. client base growing rapidly, we’re thrilled to have Debi and Greg join nudge. Their deep knowledge of the U.S. benefits landscape and their experience with leading employers will help us improve the financial health of many more American workers.

Together, Kesselring and Goebert bring a combination of benefits industry leadership and consulting expertise to nudge’s U.S. team, strengthening how the business works with employers and the consultants who support them.
